name: Read Only Memories
source: Neo-San Francisco, 2064 AD. Your life as a struggling journalist is interrupted by the world's first sapient machine, a ROM (Relationship and Organizational Manager) named Turing. Together, you and the quirky robot will encounter a colorful cast of locals and overcome challenges as you uncover the city’s secrets behind the overlapping futures of technology and humanity.
translation: 西元2064年，新舊金山。你是個潦倒的記者。世界上第一臺擁有自我意識的機器——名為圖靈的關係與組織管理者（ROM）——打斷了你的日常。你與這臺古怪的機器人一起，遇見形形色色的當地人，克服重重挑戰，逐步揭開科技與人類交疊未來背後的城市秘密。
